structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a 22-minute-old pump.fun bonding-curve coin called "d/acc", at about $20k market cap. Its creator fees are sent to @VitalikButerin through UsePaid, a fee bridge that pays X accounts via X Money. The only social link is a Vitalik tweet from November 2023 (status 1729251838581727232, his d/acc post era), not anything current. Price is up about 300-390% in 30 minutes and sits at its all-time high, with 185 unique buyers and 116 sellers. GMGN tags 65 bundler wallets among 91 holders, and the dev's X account shows 1,177 launched tokens. I found no fresh Vitalik d/acc catalyst, and an older D/ACC token already exists on Solana.

narrative.description: Vitalik's d/acc (defensive accelerationism) philosophy, plus a 'fees go to Vitalik' gimmick via UsePaid/X Money. It is an old narrative from 2023-24. Vitalik keeps discussing d/acc in AI contexts, but I found no specific trigger in the last few hours.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely generic pump.fun degen flow around a recognisable Vitalik brand plus the fee-to-celebrity trend. No organic posts about this contract were found.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is one of many UsePaid fee-to-celebrity launches. Nothing makes it the canonical d/acc token, and Vitalik has no known involvement.
token_connection.competing_tokens: An older D/ACC meme token already exists on Solana (FabjHjc1druUQoHVtudpNiCpnf73rtLzMkRM1b5NSbb6), the one that pumped 7x on Vitalik news in 2023-24. Other d/acc copies probably exist on pump.fun.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 65 bundler wallets among 91 holders, bundler traders hold 34%, the bot/degen rate is 43% and 36 wallets are fresh. The dev X account shows 1,177 launched tokens (serial launcher). There are no paid boosts, and 2 smart wallets appear. Unique buyers (185) are reasonably broad for a $20k coin.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. The contract search returned nothing. The dev X-account count may reflect the Vitalik tweet link being attributed to Vitalik's account rather than the actual deployer.

structural_risks: Heavy bundler share (65 wallets, 34% of top-trader volume) can dump into the curve
It is at its ATH after +300% in 30 minutes, so entry comes after the pump
Only 73/115 virtual SOL, so it still needs meaningful buying to migrate

structured_output.counterargument: Fee-to-Vitalik tokens have a recognisable meme hook. At a $20k market cap, a 2x only needs about $20k more demand, which is roughly one more hour like the last. Buying stays strong (m5 buys 32 vs 18 sells), top10 holdings are only about 21%, the dev holds nothing, and 2 smart wallets are in. Getting close to graduation could draw extra attention.
unknowns: Whether any X post (by Vitalik or a KOL) triggered this
Whether bundlers are the deployer's own wallets
How many competing fee-to-Vitalik d/acc tokens launched today

source_coverage.notes: Searching the contract returned nothing relevant. The UsePaid token page failed with an SSL error. News covers only the general d/acc concept and the older D/ACC token. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were skipped for time.

structured_output.thesis: A generic celebrity-fee pump.fun launch borrowing an old Vitalik narrative, with no current catalyst, heavy bundler presence and a competing older D/ACC token. It is already up 4x since launch. A below-average runner candidate, but not hopeless given the low market cap and ongoing buy pressure.
